meta.source: Itiner-e: the digital atlas of ancient roads, static version 2024 v1.3
meta.creditLine: Route follows reconstructed Roman roads (Itiner-e, CC BY 4.0). Road reconstructions are scholarly reconstructions, mostly conjectural — a plausible route, not the exact road taken.
meta.rules: Road paths only between adjacent stages both Confirmed/Probable; Hypothetical segments excluded; sea legs and region-named stages get no road path; OT journeys get no road paths (pre-Roman); path accepted only if <= 2.5x straight-line distance.
